Hi Sam / Priya —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a suggested Mutual Action Plan (MAP) milestone that will help keep the procurement and security review on-track. I captured owners and target dates below — please flag anything that needs to shift.

Summary of ask from NorthBridge: security review of hosted offering + delivery of SOC 2 questionnaire responses and sample evidence (logs, retention config, access controls).

Proposed MAP milestones (draft):
- Security questionnaire returned (prefilled PDF) — Owner: NorthBridge security team — Target: 2026-09-21
- Evidence manifest (list of artifacts & delivery method) — Owner: NorthBridge / Redwood (joint) — Target: 2026-09-24
- Redwood provides SOC 2 assurance package (control narratives, auditor contact, latest report summary) — Owner: Redwood (Marissa) — Target: 2026-09-28
- Final security acceptance & procurement sign-off — Owner: NorthBridge procurement — Target: 2026-10-05

Dependencies / notes:
- If NorthBridge requires the full SOC 2 report (not just summary), timelines may extend by ~3 business days while we validate NDAs.
- Evidence handoff: we can share logs via secure Drive link or SFTP. Please indicate your preferred delivery method in the returned questionnaire.

Attachments: RBW-MAP-v1.3.xlsx (draft MAP with responsibilities), NorthBridge_SOC2_Questionnaire_v1.pdf (blank copy)

Next steps:
1) Please return the prefilling of the questionnaire by 2026-09-21 (Sam / security team).
2) Marissa will assemble the assurance package and control narratives once we have confirmation on NDA status (cc'd).
3) Ben will coordinate the evidence transfer and provide a small sample manifest we expect to deliver.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 15m follow-up if helpful.
